notes.title: NEW TITLE, ACHIEVEMENTS AND LEADERBOARD
notes.notes: We've decided to change the title of the game from Hell's Kitchen to Kitchen Gore to avoid confusion with the american tv show. We also added achievements (icons will be in place soon too) and a leaderboard for the survival mode!

notes.title: Small tweak
notes.notes: Our last update fixed the pan flicking when turning bug for some, but not for all. Hopefully with this new tweak we adress the problem for others as well
